description:
Are you a dedicated Physical Therapist (PT) seeking an urgent opportunity to make a significant impact? A premier health and rehabilitation center in Gainesville, FL, is actively seeking a passionate Physical Therapist to join their dynamic team. This role offers a competitive hourly rate and the chance to contribute to patient recovery and well-being in a supportive environment.

As a Physical Therapist, you will be responsible for providing comprehensive rehabilitation services, developing individualized treatment plans, and collaborating with a multidisciplinary team to achieve optimal patient outcomes. This is an urgent hiring need, presenting an excellent opportunity for a motivated professional to step into a rewarding role quickly.
requirements: Current Physical Therapist (PT) license in the state of Florida
Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) degree from an accredited program
Experience working in a skilled nursing facility or similar rehabilitation setting preferred
Strong clinical assessment and treatment planning skills
Ability to work collaboratively within a healthcare team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $38.00 - $48.00, compensation based on experience.
